title: events/envelope
description: Canonical event envelope per specs/001-fork-bootstrap-contracts/contracts/canonical-event-envelope.md (FR-007/FR-008). Every record carries schema_version, a unique evt.* event_id, episode link, monotonic sequence, registered event_type, game_tick, wall_time_utc, source, correlation refs, revision-set, event_type-discriminated payload, and privacy classification. Absent != null != unknown != censored (CONTRACTS.md 5.4): nullable fields below are required keys whose null value means 'applicable but unavailable', never success. schema_version carries NO maximum here: the consumer max is consumer policy, so archival readers can still schema-validate newer records losslessly while strict consumers emit {ok:false,error:{code:'schema.version.too_new'}} per compatibility/VERSIONING.md (implemented by contracts.eventmap.consume_strict).

schema_version.description: Envelope contract revision. Deliberately unbounded above: strict consumers compare against their own max and reject with code schema.version.too_new; the schema itself stays open so archival readers preserve newer records.

event_id.description: Unique record identifier; evt.* kind per common/id grammar.

episode_id.description: Owning episode (ep.* ID); null for pre-episode system events.

sequence.description: Monotonic within the episode stream. Cross-record ordering (strictly increasing; duplicates/gaps flagged) is checked at load, not by this schema.

event_type.description: Registered family.name type from the versioned event-type registry (registry/event-map.yaml). Payload is discriminated by this value; unknown types are preserved in storage and rejected by strict execution consumers.

game_tick.description: Game tick at emission; null when unknowable (upstream bus.py records have no tick source outside payload data).

wall_time_utc.description: RFC 3339 wall-clock emission time; always present.

source.description: Emitting component, e.g. 'rimagent.bus' for upstream-mapped records.

correlation.description: Links to plan/goal/task/attempt/request/intent/command and parent event; null when no upstream source exists (R5: never fabricated).

revisions.description: Revision-set of producing code/policy/model (common/revision-set); null when there is no upstream source (R5: never fabricated).

payload.description: Event-type-discriminated payload; validated against schemas/events/types/<event_type>.schema.json by the consumer.

classification.description: restricted payloads (e.g. model.reasoning) are omitted from shared profiles per the envelope contract mapping notes.

redactions.description: Field paths redacted from this record; empty when none applied.

idref.description: Optional namespaced ID reference (null = known-absent link).
